name: Default
shortDescription: Web-based client for the Soulseek file sharing network to search, download, share and chat from the browser.

alerts.message: slskd does not connect to the Soulseek network until you set your Soulseek username and password in SLSKD_SLSK_USERNAME and SLSKD_SLSK_PASSWORD, or in the YAML editor under System > Options in the web UI. Sign in to the web UI as slskd with the generated SLSKD_PASSWORD.
Only the web UI is routed. The Soulseek listen port 50300 does not accept incoming peer connections, so transfers with peers that cannot accept incoming connections either may fail.
